query: How do I make stovetop cheese pasta?

goal.title: Make stovetop macaroni with cheese sauce
goal.description: Drain already-cooked macaroni, make a milk, butter and shredded mozzarella sauce in the emptied pan, combine and season the pasta, then scrape it into a white serving bowl.
goal.final_state: Macaroni in pale cheese sauce rests in a white bowl with a fork. The pan is back on the stove with some sauce left inside.

procedure.description: The clip begins with pasta already boiling in a covered pan. Adjust the stove, hold the lid knob briefly, grip the hot pan with a red oven mitt, remove the lid and set it on the rear pan. Carry the hot pan to the sink, move a cup out of the way and retrieve a mesh strainer. Pour out cooking water, then tip the pasta into the strainer. Return both to the stove and cover the pasta-filled strainer on the rear pan.

Adjust the front burner, fetch a glass from the sink and set it on the counter. Retrieve wrapped butter and a knife, cut off butter into the emptied front pan and set the wrapper aside. Adjust the burner again, move the milk carton near the stove, pick up a fork and push the butter around the pan; a solid chunk remains at the end of this phase.

Lift and uncap the milk carton while setting the fork aside, pour milk into the pan, recap and return the carton. Open a bag of shredded mozzarella and pour it into the milk in two passes. Set the bag aside, move the carton, retrieve the fork and repeatedly stir the milk, cheese and butter into a pale sauce.

Remove the lid from the pasta-filled strainer, lift the strainer and tip the pasta into the cheese sauce, scraping remaining pieces out with the fork. Put the empty strainer on the rear pan and stir the pasta thoroughly. Replace the lid over the strainer, move a white serving bowl beside the stove and continue stirring before leaving the fork in the pan.

Open the green-lidded seasoning jar, shake pale granules over the pasta, close and return the jar. Stir with the fork, open the white salt container, shake it over the pasta, close and put it down. Stir again and grasp the hot pan handle through the oven mitt.

Lift and tilt the pan over the white bowl. Keep holding its handle with the left mitt while repeatedly scraping macaroni and sauce into the bowl with the right-hand fork. Stop pouring while some pale sauce remains in the pan, return the pan to the stove and stir the macaroni in the bowl. Briefly lift the bowl, lower it to the counter and release it with the fork left inside.
